ideas.title: Uncovering the Full Extent of Feeding Our Future Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future program for potential fraud and connections to other programs or entities
questions: What is the full extent of the fraud?
Are there connections to other programs or entities?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future program has shown signs of fraudulent activity, with multiple individuals pleading guilty. Further investigation is needed to uncover the full extent of the fraud and to identify any potential connections to other programs or entities.
